tools.name: chain_token_report
tools.description: Token security check (honeypot detector + rug-pull risk score) for a Base ERC-20 in one call, decision-grade trade-safety verdict: SAFE | CAUTION | AVOID plus risk_score (0-100) and reasons, bundling honeypot/sellability simulation, owner-renounced + mint/pause/blacklist/fee-setter/upgradeable-proxy checks, token symbol/name/decimals, and Uniswap v3 WETH-pool liquidity (USD). Replaces many RPC calls and prevents a bad trade. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via the shared MCP payment gate (the direct HTTP endpoint GET /chain/token-report is $0.01 — MCP tools/call is gated at a flat $0.005 per request).

tools.name: chain_token_security
tools.description: Token security / honeypot detector for a Base mainnet ERC-20: EIP-1967/1822 proxy + upgradeability detection, bytecode dispatcher scan for mint/pause/blacklist/fee-setter/ownership selectors, owner() renouncement check, and a live eth_call state-override simulation testing whether a synthetic wallet can actually transfer() the token. Returns risk_score (0-100) + verdict (clear/review/block) + human-readable flags. Real compute an agent can't trivially self-serve. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: gate_swap
tools.description: Pre-trade GO / HOLD / BLOCK gate for a Base ERC-20 swap: honeypot/sellability + admin-control checks + Uniswap v3 liquidity vs. your trade size. Returns the GO/HOLD/BLOCK decision AND decision-grade sizing — per $100 / $1k / $10k / $50k (and your exact notional_usd): entry-slippage + exit-simulation (net USD recovered vs lost to slippage), round-trip breakeven move %, and max_safe_notional_usd. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via the shared MCP payment gate (the direct HTTP endpoint GET /gate/swap is $0.008 — MCP tools/call is gated at a flat $0.005 per request).

tools.name: scan_mcp_server
tools.description: Security-audit a target MCP server for prompt-injection / tool-poisoning. Fetches the server's advertised tools and statically analyzes each for hidden instructions, data-exfiltration hints, dangerous capabilities, cross-tool shadowing, and invisible-unicode payloads (OWASP LLM01/LLM08). Returns findings + a 0-100 risk score + verdict (clear/review/block). Cost: $0.005 USDC per scan via x402 (GET /scan/mcp HTTP variant is $0.05).

url.description: Target MCP server endpoint URL to audit
